name: Fuwatale Component

title.zh: Fuwatale · 按主题购买立体图标

description.zh: 看学校包左侧包介绍与文件说明，对照右侧首排样张看质感。 Fuwatale按主题提供黏土风立体图标包，具体包列出PNG与Blender设计文件。素材按页面方案付费，许可允许合规个人及客户成品，但禁止原始或改编素材再分发、素材主导商品及AI训练。
description.en: Fuwatale offers themed clay-style 3D icon packs with PNG and Blender design files. Paid offers permit compliant personal and client final works, while restricting redistribution of original or modified assets, asset-led merchandise, and AI training; individual pack and access-plan conditions remain separate.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Fuwatale (https://www.fuwatale.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看学校包左侧包介绍与文件说明，对照右侧首排样张看质感。

Visual details from source observation: 我们从首页的天空云层横幅看黏土风图标，再到目录比较主题包；学校包右侧可见算盘、闹钟、字母积木、自行车和书本，风格圆鼓厚实。先看具体包的PNG与Blender文件说明，再核所购方案，不能把设计文件当程序源码。许可允许合规最终作品，但禁止素材再分发、素材主导商品和AI训练；本次没有购买或验包。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).

offers.name: Fuwatale Lifetime All Access
offers.scope: Fuwatale购买后的3D图标PNG和Blender设计文件（及自作渲染），个人/商业最终作品按custom许可；禁止独立原始/改编资产或渲染集转卖再分发、资产主导商品及AI模型训练。可将Blender文件交该客户仅用于该项目，内部团队同组织使用；不可把Blender设计文件当软件源码公开。 本offer仅$99（币种未核）一次购买Lifetime All Access，全现有pack及未来更新，不混单包折扣或免费试用。未购买/验包。

pricing.quote: One time payment of $99 for lifetime access to the full library, including future icons.
